quote: On upgrade, an existing interrupted delegated session without surviving sender authority can now be tombstoned, including an unsent final without a queue owner. The intended fail-closed contract and user recovery outcome need explicit maintainer acceptance and existing-state proof.
note: The earlier P1 merge-risk item identified the tombstone and asked for proof of the user recovery outcome, leaving the same-conversation failure for fresh authenticated messages unstated. The maintainer answered with a probe that showed the tombstone and a /new or /reset notice.
